summary: ChangeLens is a browser-based tool that helps anyone detect and understand change in Earth science data. Users select a variable and region, or paste their own series such as NASA GISTEMP temperature data, and see the time series with a trend line. The tool answers the challenge’s four questions: what is changing, where, how much, and whether the change is significant. It reports Sen’s slope per decade and total change, applies the Mann-Kendall test at the 95% level, and returns a plain-language verdict. A regional comparison table reveals opposite trends in different places, even when one process drives both. We validated the method on 1,500 simulated series per case: false alarms matched the expected 5% rate, and slopes were recovered accurately. Demo data is synthetic; paste real data. Planned upgrades include autocorrelation correction, live NASA data access, and map views.
